name: fl_code_review
description: Two-axis independent code review engine evaluating changes along Axis 1 (Standards compliance & Fowler code smells like high complexity, long functions, primitive obsession, duplicate hunks) and Axis 2 (Spec and requirement conformance, detecting scope creep and missing acceptance criteria).
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'review_diff' (default, reviews git diff against fixed point), 'review_file' (reviews single file for smells), or 'inspect_smells'.

repo_path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to current working directory ('.').

fixed_point.description: Git ref to compare HEAD against (e.g. 'HEAD~1', 'main', or commit SHA). Defaults to 'HEAD~1'.

target_file.description: Path to target file if action is 'review_file'.

spec_path.description: Path to specification or requirements markdown file for Axis 2 spec evaluation.

standards_path.description: Path to repository standards or guidelines file for Axis 1 evaluation.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
